sources.title: Summit hardware threads
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Sierra：主機核心保留與執行緒超額配置
related.titleEn: Sierra: reserved host cores and oversubscription
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付六GPU工作表、裝置身份核對及缺工作回歸測試；30/35正確，GPU映射唯一，所有工作結果與單工作參考一致；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver six-GPU assignments, identity checks and missing-work regression tests. Verify 30/35, unique device mapping and every result against a one-job reference. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫四個程序的10核心綁定集合，另列保留核心；應用不可把實體總數當可用數；1與1.2可重算，交接表包含所有執行緒來源與可用核心依據。
related.differenceEn: Draw four disjoint ten-core affinity sets and reserved cores; applications must not equate physical count with allowance. Reproduce 1 and 1.2 with all thread sources and the basis for allowed cores documented.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每GPU分配m個等成本工作、每個t毫秒，節點完成時間由max(m)×t決定；合成36個工作、六GPU、每工作5毫秒；另案42工作，忽略傳輸；名義式 (36/6)*5 = 30 ms；變更式 (42/6)*5 = 35 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
r個程序各t個執行緒需要r×t個執行槽；超額比為r×t/C，C是被允許的核心數；合成C=40，r=4，t=10；誤改t=12，其餘配置不變；名義式 4*10/40 = 1 requested/allowed core ratio；變更式 4*12/40 = 1.2 requested/allowed core ratio。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With m equal-cost jobs per GPU at t milliseconds each, node completion is max(m)×t. Synthetic 36 jobs, six GPUs, 5 ms/job; compare 42 jobs, excluding transfers. Nominal (36/6)*5 = 30 ms; changed (42/6)*5 = 35 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

r processes with t threads need r×t execution slots; oversubscription is r×t/C for allowed cores C. Teaching C 40, r 4, t 10; compare accidental t 12 with other settings fixed. Nominal 4*10/40 = 1 requested/allowed core ratio; changed 4*12/40 = 1.2 requested/allowed core ratio. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GotoBLAS 式分塊：矩陣資料重用
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付六GPU工作表、裝置身份核對及缺工作回歸測試；30/35正確，GPU映射唯一，所有工作結果與單工作參考一致；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver six-GPU assignments, identity checks and missing-work regression tests. Verify 30/35, unique device mapping and every result against a one-job reference. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 標A行塊、B列塊、C累加塊與外迴圈次序；重用來自迴圈安排而非僅有方塊名稱；24576/98304正確，尾端覆蓋65×65且預算包含額外緩衝。
related.differenceEn: Label A-row, B-column and C-accumulator tiles with loop order; reuse comes from ordering, not naming tiles. Counts match, all 65×65 outputs are covered and extra buffers enter the budget.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每GPU分配m個等成本工作、每個t毫秒，節點完成時間由max(m)×t決定；合成36個工作、六GPU、每工作5毫秒；另案42工作，忽略傳輸；名義式 (36/6)*5 = 30 ms；變更式 (42/6)*5 = 35 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
FP64的A、B、C各b×b塊，理想工作集M=3b²×8 bytes，忽略額外打包與對齊；教學b32對64；可用快取預算96KiB，並非某處理器真實快取；名義式 3*32**2*8 = 24576 bytes；變更式 3*64**2*8 = 98304 bytes。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With m equal-cost jobs per GPU at t milliseconds each, node completion is max(m)×t. Synthetic 36 jobs, six GPUs, 5 ms/job; compare 42 jobs, excluding transfers. Nominal (36/6)*5 = 30 ms; changed (42/6)*5 = 35 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Three FP64 b×b tiles have ideal working set M=3 b²×8 bytes, excluding extra packing/alignment. Teaching b 32 versus 64 with 96 KiB available cache budget, not a processor specification. Nominal 3*32**2*8 = 24576 bytes; changed 3*64**2*8 = 98304 bytes. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
